ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL DATA-INCONSISTENCY: 0 student rows rendered for every class option (Nursery..12th) because the page filters by CLASS_OPTIONS values ('1st','2nd','...','10th','11th','12th') but seeded students in /app/frontend/src/services/demoStore.js line 9-13 use Roman-numeral classNames ('X', 'IX', 'VIII', 'XII', 'VII'). Result: yp-hold-*/yp-reason-* never render, commit shows 'No students to promote' toast, and the spec verification ('Aanya Iyer 7th → 8th if not held') cannot be exercised. Either normalise seed students to '10th'/'9th'/'8th'/'12th'/'7th', or map Roman ↔ Arabic in the filter and NEXT_CLASS map.

Parent (parent@demo.school, child Aanya Iyer className='VII') sees 'No exams scheduled' because demo exams es1–es4 are seeded with className='10th' while the student record uses 'VII'. Same root cause as the Promotion bug — Roman-vs-Arabic class-name mismatch. Admin view shows the 4 rows correctly; parent view is silent due to filter.

After clicking payroll-generate, console emits 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning AND the pr-row-* / pr-status-* / pr-payslip-* triplets render duplicated for the same payroll record (e.g. pr-row-payroll-1778525011840 appears twice). Idempotency contract per the spec ('idempotent per month') is violated: re-running generate appears to push duplicate records into demoStore rather than upserting on (employeeId, monthKey). Suggest dedupe in payroll-generate handler and use a stable key (`${empId}-${month}`) for the rendered list.

React hydration warning: <button> nested inside <button>. The outer st-subj-sub1 is a <motion.button> and it contains st-edit-subj-sub1 and st-del-subj-sub1 <button> elements. Browsers will auto-close the outer button on hydration. Refactor outer container to <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> + onKeyDown, or move the edit/del buttons outside the clickable card.

Missing data-testids for fields explicitly listed in the review spec: lp-objectives, lp-method, lp-date, lp-period (LessonPlanning.jsx lines 121–125). The inputs/selects/textareas exist but cannot be targeted by the spec's listed test-ids. lp-title, lp-subject, lp-teacher, lp-class, lp-section, lp-save-draft, lp-submit are present.

integration_issues.issue: NEXT_CLASS only maps Arabic ordinals ('1st'→'2nd', …, '10th'→'11th'). Even if students were filtered correctly, students stored as 'X' would never find a next-class mapping. Promotion will silently no-op on existing seed data.

critical_code_review_comments: Major schema inconsistency in /app/frontend/src/services/demoStore.js: students seeded with Roman-numeral classes while every other entity (lessonPlans, examSchedule, diaryEntries, subjects partially) uses Arabic ordinals — silently breaks two role-aware flows. Must standardise.
Payroll component pushes new records each call to generate() without checking for existing (empId, month) pair — violates idempotency contract documented in the review spec.

SubjectsTopicsCRUD couples the subject-row click target and the per-row CRUD buttons as nested <button> — HTML-invalid; React warns on hydration; iOS Safari will close outer button on touchstart making the CRUD buttons unclickable in some cases.

Firestore initialisation is loud — emits an unhandled error to console on every page load when the project has no data. AuthContext/TenantContext fall back as expected, so the connection should be either deferred (init lazily on first write) or wrapped to log at debug level.

rca of the issue: Root cause for Promotion 0-rows + Parent ExamTimetable empty: Two parallel class-name conventions in demoStore.js seed: students use Roman numerals (line 9-13: 'X','IX','VIII','XII','VII'), while lessonPlans (line 140-142), examSchedule (145-148), diaryEntries (151+), and YearEndPromotion's CLASS_OPTIONS/NEXT_CLASS map use Arabic ordinals ('10th','9th',etc). String equality comparison ('X' === '10th') fails → empty filter result → empty UI tables. The fix is one-line per affected student: change 'X' → '10th', 'IX' → '9th', 'VIII' → '8th', 'XII' → '12th', 'VII' → '7th'. Root cause for Payroll duplicate keys: payroll generation appends new objects with Date.now() ids without an existence check on (employeeId, monthKey), so each click of payroll-generate adds another set of N employee records; React then warns on duplicate keys when the same employee appears twice. Fix: in handleGenerate, filter out existing records for the selected month before push, or use upsert keyed by `${empId}-${monthKey}`.
